episodes.title: What is a Game?
episodes.description: Explore what makes an activity a game, who plays games, and how games affect people.

episodes.title: Ancient Games
episodes.description: From the ancient Egyptian game of Senet to the Aztec’s Patolli, games have been played since the beginning of civilization.

episodes.title: The Dawn of Video Games
episodes.description: Trace early video game history back to reprogrammable computers in the 1940s.

episodes.title: Atari and the Business of Video Games
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Games, Andre Meadows talks about the rise of Atari, and with it, the rise of the video game industry.

episodes.title: The First Home Consoles
episodes.description: Explore how competition between consoles improved graphics, storytelling, and gameplay.

episodes.title: The Video Game Crash of 1983
episodes.description: Trace how market saturation, rushed releases, and declining consumer confidence contributed to the 1983 American video game crash.

episodes.title: Nintendo and a New Standard for Video Games
episodes.description: Discover how Nintendo used developer contracts to establish new expectations for video game quality.

episodes.title: Sega and More Mature Video Games
episodes.description: Explore the growth of mature game content and the development of the ESRB rating system.

episodes.title: Playstation and More Immersive Video Games
episodes.description: Explore PlayStation-era console competition, 3D graphics, CD-based storytelling, multiplayer games, and growing immersion.

episodes.title: Microsoft and Connected Consoles
episodes.description: Today, we wrap up our discussion of the console wars by taking a look at Microsoft’s Xbox which was announced in 2001.

episodes.title: Casual Gaming
episodes.description: Explore the growth of casual gaming as internet-connected devices became widespread.

episodes.title: MMORPGs
episodes.description: Trace MMORPGs from early text adventures to persistent online communities and economies.

episodes.title: Card Games
episodes.description: We'll look at a wide variety of card games like Poker, Yu-Gi-Oh, Pokemon TCG, and Magic: The Gathering.

episodes.title: Board Games
episodes.description: Compare Monopoly and The Settlers of Catan to understand American and European approaches to board game design.

episodes.title: Educational Games
episodes.description: Explore games designed to teach useful skills, their long history, and examples of educational gaming successes.

episodes.title: Psychology of Gaming
episodes.description: Explore why people prefer different games and what those preferences reveal about players.

episodes.title: The Olympics, FIFA, and Why We Love Sports
episodes.description: John Green explores sports as games and the appeal of large international sporting competitions.

episodes.title: Role-playing Games
episodes.description: Explore role-playing games as interactive storytelling, their roots in wargaming, and the controversy surrounding Dungeons & Dragons.

episodes.title: Game Design
episodes.description: Good game design is essential for a positive player experience whether it’s a board game, video game, or even dice game.

episodes.title: PC Gaming
episodes.description: Explore the development of gaming on personal computers.

episodes.title: The Future of Virtual Reality
episodes.description: Look back at the decades-long history of virtual reality games.

episodes.title: Open World Games
episodes.description: Explore open-world games, player-created stories, social interaction, and the hardware advances supporting their growth.

episodes.title: Handhelds
episodes.description: Examine the relationship between mobile games and dedicated handheld gaming systems.

episodes.title: Input Devices
episodes.description: Explore how increasingly complex video games have influenced improvements in game controllers.

episodes.title: The History of Game Shows
episodes.description: Investigate game shows and the ways they turn play into entertainment.

episodes.title: LARP
episodes.description: Explore live-action role-playing beyond its familiar foam-weapon stereotype.

episodes.title: Gambling
episodes.description: Trace gambling’s history, its connections with other games, and the appeal of uncertain outcomes.

episodes.title: The Pokémon Phenomenon
episodes.description: Investigate the reasons behind Pokémon’s success rather than treating its popularity as an accident.

episodes.title: The Future of Gaming
episodes.description: Conclude the series by considering what lies ahead for games.
